ranking: ascending SHA256(UTF8(salt + NUL + query_id)), then query_id
scope: Twelve development questions for setup and failure observation; not a confirmatory sample. Remaining IDs are unused candidates, not a certified independent test split.
rejection_policy: Stop on wrong count, duplicate/invalid IDs or revision mismatch. Never replace a selected question based on contents, observed outcomes or positive-document labels.
information_boundary: Select IDs before reading/decrypting query text. Executor receives selected ID/query only and independent full-corpus search/open tools. Answer, evidence and gold-document labels remain evaluator-only.
